name: deployment-local
title: This machine's service: systemd on Linux, launchd on macOS, no Docker
description: Runs a pikit project as a service of this machine without Docker: a systemd user unit on Linux, a launchd user agent on macOS, restarted when it exits or /health answers 503. The process entrypoint, its rotated JSON-lines log, the unit and plist templates, and the commands `pikit up | down | restart | logs | status | dev` delegate to.
